items.question: Does the UAE business bankruptcy law (Federal Decree-Law No. 51 of 2023) apply to banks licensed by the Central Bank?
items.gold: No, Central Bank-licensed banks, financial institutions and insurers are governed by separate laws.
items.fact: Central Bank-licensed banks excluded from business bankruptcy law

items.question: Which Federal Decree-Law number governs business bankruptcy in the UAE?
items.gold: Federal Decree-Law No. 51 of 2023 Promulgating the Financial and Bankruptcy Law.
items.fact: Business bankruptcy governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 51
